issue.title: Finish capture lists — section names with spaces, header completion, and undoable ID splices
issue.description: A list header can name any section, including one whose title has spaces (`@sase#future-work` or `@sase#"Future Work"` both reach `## Future Work`). Picking a section from the menu always inserts a selector that reaches that section. Route and section completion work on a list header even after bullets are typed below it. Accepting a block ID in Bob Mac Capture is one native Undo step. With this done, bob-cli-fn can land.
